retained_rationale.adapter_primitives: generic matrix/site perturbations and execution math: LoRA, probabilistic/spectral variants, steering, prompts, attention bias, value readout and custom site services; no task IDs or dreamer/memory roles
retained_rationale.data_services: Task/Trajectory records, CAS task IO and deterministic generic splitting
retained_rationale.generic_demos: synthetic arithmetic fixtures used only to demonstrate/qualify shared host, routing, checkpoint and serving services; original research launch recipes preserved externally
